title: 禮貌用語
description: 有禮貌地提出請求與回應

sentences.en: Would you mind terribly if I asked you to lower your voice a bit, since I'm trying to concentrate on this report that's due tomorrow?
sentences.zh: 你介意我請你稍微降低音量嗎？因為我正在努力專注於明天要交的報告。

sentences.en: I would be extremely grateful if you could spare a few minutes of your time to help me understand this complicated procedure.
sentences.zh: 如果你能撥出幾分鐘的時間幫我了解這個複雜的程序，我會非常感激。

sentences.en: Please don't hesitate to let me know if there's anything at all I can do to make your stay here more comfortable.
sentences.zh: 如果有任何我能做的事讓你在這裡住得更舒適，請不要猶豫告訴我。

sentences.en: I hope I'm not imposing, but would it be possible for you to recommend a good restaurant in this area for a special occasion?
sentences.zh: 我希望我沒有造成打擾，但你能推薦這個地區適合特殊場合的好餐廳嗎？

sentences.en: If it's not too much trouble, could you possibly show me how to operate this machine, since I've never used one before?
sentences.zh: 如果不會太麻煩的話，你能教我怎麼操作這台機器嗎？因為我之前從沒用過。

sentences.en: I appreciate your patience in explaining this to me again, and I apologize for not understanding it the first time around.
sentences.zh: 我很感謝你有耐心再次向我解釋這件事，我為第一次沒有理解而道歉。

sentences.en: Would it be alright with you if we rescheduled our meeting to next Thursday, as something urgent has come up that requires my immediate attention?
sentences.zh: 我們可以把會議改到下週四嗎？因為有件緊急的事需要我立即處理。

sentences.en: I'd like to respectfully suggest an alternative approach to this problem, if you wouldn't mind hearing a different perspective on the matter.
sentences.zh: 如果你不介意聽聽不同的觀點，我想恭敬地建議另一種解決這個問題的方法。

sentences.en: Pardon me for interrupting your conversation, but I believe you may have accidentally dropped your wallet near the entrance over there.
sentences.zh: 抱歉打斷你的對話，但我相信你可能不小心把錢包掉在那邊入口附近了。

sentences.en: It would mean a great deal to me if you could attend my graduation ceremony next month, as your support has been invaluable throughout.
sentences.zh: 如果你能參加我下個月的畢業典禮，對我意義重大，因為你的支持一直是無價的。

sentences.en: I understand that you're quite busy at the moment, so please feel free to get back to me whenever it's most convenient for you.
sentences.zh: 我理解你現在很忙，所以請在你最方便的時候回覆我就好。

sentences.en: May I kindly ask whether it would be possible to extend the deadline by just a couple of days, given the unexpected circumstances?
sentences.zh: 鑒於意外的情況，我可以禮貌地問一下是否有可能把截止日期延長幾天嗎？

sentences.en: I truly value your opinion on this matter, which is precisely why I wanted to consult with you before making any final decisions.
sentences.zh: 我真的很重視你在這件事上的意見，這正是為什麼我想在做最終決定前先徵詢你的看法。

sentences.en: If you happen to have a moment later today, I would love to discuss a small favor that I've been meaning to ask of you.
sentences.zh: 如果你今天稍後有空的話，我想討論一個我一直想請你幫的小忙。

sentences.en: I'm terribly sorry for the inconvenience this may cause, but I'm afraid I need to cancel our appointment due to a family emergency.
sentences.zh: 我非常抱歉這可能造成的不便，但恐怕我需要因為家庭緊急狀況取消我們的約定。

sentences.en: With all due respect, I believe there might be a more efficient way to handle this task, and I'd be happy to elaborate if you're interested.
sentences.zh: 恕我直言，我認為可能有更有效率的方式來處理這個任務，如果你有興趣的話我很樂意詳細說明。

sentences.en: I was hoping you might be able to point me in the right direction, since I'm completely new to this building and seem to have gotten lost.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能為我指個方向，因為我對這棟建築完全不熟悉，似乎迷路了。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for taking the time to meet with me today — I know how valuable your time is, and I truly appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 非常感謝你今天撥出時間跟我見面——我知道你的時間有多寶貴，我真的很感激。

sentences.en: I wonder if I might trouble you for a glass of water, as I've been walking for quite a while and am feeling rather dehydrated.
sentences.zh: 不知道我能不能麻煩你給我一杯水，因為我走了很久，覺得相當脫水。

sentences.en: Please accept my sincerest apologies for the delay in responding to your email, as I was traveling abroad without reliable internet access.
sentences.zh: 請接受我最誠摯的道歉，因為回覆你的電子郵件延遲了，我當時在國外旅行，沒有穩定的網路。

sentences.en: It's very kind of you to offer, and while I appreciate the gesture enormously, I wouldn't want to put you out in any way.
sentences.zh: 你的提議太好了，雖然我非常感激這個舉動，但我不想給你添任何麻煩。

sentences.en: I hope you don't mind my saying so, but I think the presentation would benefit greatly from including a few more visual examples.
sentences.zh: 我希望你不介意我這樣說，但我認為簡報如果加上更多視覺範例會大有幫助。

sentences.en: Would you be so kind as to pass along my regards to your family, and please let them know they're welcome to visit anytime?
sentences.zh: 能否請你代我向你的家人問好，並請讓他們知道隨時歡迎來訪？

sentences.en: I do apologize for bringing this up again, but I believe there's been a misunderstanding regarding the terms we discussed last week.
sentences.zh: 我確實為再次提起這件事而道歉，但我認為關於我們上週討論的條款存在誤解。

sentences.en: If it wouldn't be too much of an imposition, could I possibly borrow your notes from yesterday's lecture, since I was unable to attend?
sentences.zh: 如果不會太過分的話，我能借你昨天課堂的筆記嗎？因為我無法出席。

sentences.en: I'm writing to kindly request your assistance with a project that I believe would benefit greatly from your expertise in this field.
sentences.zh: 我寫信是想禮貌地請求你協助一個專案，我認為你在這個領域的專業會使它大有助益。

sentences.en: Please don't feel obligated to say yes, but I thought I'd ask whether you might be available to give a short talk at our event.
sentences.zh: 請不要覺得有義務答應，但我想問問你是否可能有空在我們的活動上做個簡短演講。

sentences.en: I want to express how much I admire the work you've done here, and I hope we can find opportunities to collaborate in the future.
sentences.zh: 我想表達我多麼欽佩你在這裡所做的工作，我希望我們未來能找到合作的機會。

sentences.en: Forgive me if this is an inappropriate question, but I'm curious about the cultural significance behind the tradition you mentioned earlier.
sentences.zh: 如果這是個不恰當的問題請原諒我，但我很好奇你剛才提到的那個傳統背後的文化意義。

sentences.en: I would be honored if you would consider joining us for dinner this evening, as we're celebrating a milestone that means a lot to our team.
sentences.zh: 如果你願意考慮今晚加入我們的晚餐，我會感到榮幸，因為我們正在慶祝一個對我們團隊意義重大的里程碑。
